interpretation.ordinary: No Worklet time metrics exist for ordinary runs. Null timing is preserved and is not a zero-cost or no-overrun result.
interpretation.means: Render and total means are weighted by valid measured-window blocks; warmup is excluded. Quantile intervals are from merged histograms, never averaged per-run quantiles.
interpretation.clocks: Observed wall-clock spans include possible OS/browser descheduling and timer effects. Date.now is non-monotonic; the 1ms subtraction is a declared assumption, not a proven precision guarantee or CPU-time measurement.
interpretation.quantiles: Intervals bound observed timer-delta histogram bins only; a narrow bin does not remove timer quantization from the underlying elapsed duration.
interpretation.conditionalCounts: Raw threshold counts and beyond-nominal-1ms counts do not establish actual device underruns or audible glitches.
interpretation.comparisons: Two reversed-order repetitions give descriptive paired differences, ranges and sign counts only. They do not isolate causation, establish statistical significance or prove timer/UI/PCM-scan overhead.
interpretation.progress: Initial/end RPC bookends include warmup and approximate message timing. Producer positions, AudioContext logical time and main-thread performance.now wall deltas are retained separately; their differences do not establish dropped device frames, CPU time or an identical measured PCM/cost window. Ordinary approximate window bookends are separate again.
interpretation.scan: Capture scalar scans include warmup plus the measured window. Timing aggregates include only the measured window; their frame counts must not be conflated.
interpretation.limits: No listening, whole-song compatibility, long-term/background/device stability or hardware fidelity conclusion.
